# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly driving away from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dressed in his best clothes. Intrigued, she walks over to visit [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to find out where he went. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to the station to collect an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) whom they are adopting, leaving Mrs. [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) thoroughly shocked and skeptical about the decision.

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but learns from the stationmaster that a young girl was dropped off instead. He meets the talkative young orphan and decides to bring her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to handle the mistake, enjoying her lively chatter along the drive.

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the girl toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), listening to her imaginative musings about her red hair and the places they pass, including the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and Barry's pond. The child expresses her deep longing for a real home as she identifies [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from the road. As they arrive at the farm, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) feels a growing dread over having to break the news that a boy was expected instead.

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), French, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to find a girl instead of the expected boy. Devastated to learn she is unwanted, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears before introducing herself and explaining the mistake. After a solemn supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed in the east gable room, after which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) debate whether to keep her.

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), Snow Queen** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the beautiful morning view from her window before being called to breakfast by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). During breakfast and while doing chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks exuberantly, which makes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) nervous and highlights Matthew's quiet desire to keep the girl. Refusing to go outside to avoid falling further in love with the place, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) names Marilla's houseplant Bonny before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to take her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md).

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to recount her life story. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes growing up as an orphan, moving between overworked families who used her for childcare, and eventually being sent to the asylum. Listening to Anne's history, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel deep pity for the girl and privately considers keeping her.

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) Cove to investigate how the mix-up occurred, only to find that Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is eager to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a domestic helper. Reluctant to leave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stalls and brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Later while milking cows with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to officially adopt [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though she decides to wait until morning to break the good news to the girl.

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [God](../character/god.md), Snow Queen** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs to bed, scolding her for being untidy and discovering that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never been taught how to say her prayers. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites a uniquely improvised prayer at Marilla's prompting, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to the kitchen shocked by Anne's spiritual ignorance and resolves to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she will educate the girl properly.

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) assigns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, but Anne's tendency to chatter and daydream repeatedly distracts her. After being sent to her gable room to finish memorizing, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her new home and imagines her future in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and makes blunt, critical remarks about Anne's red hair and appearance. In a fit of fury, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explodes at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), insulting her back before fleeing to her bedroom. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gently reprimands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, ordering her to stay there until she agrees to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her room. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees, informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they walk over to Mrs. Lynde's house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatically thorough apology. Touched by Anne's performance, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) forgives her and gives her hope about her hair color, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) both relieved and amused as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, which disappoints [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) because none of them feature puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her plain hat with wild flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of Sunday school, criticizing the dry lesson and long sermon while confessing her envy of the other girls' puffed sleeves.

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers for church, but then takes her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) immediately become fast friends and solemnize their friendship with an oath in the garden. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to chocolate sweets, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she is growing fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [William Bell](../character/william-bell.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after playing late and excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her attend and promises to bake a basket of food for her, which leads [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to impulsively embrace and kiss her. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits down to do her patchwork sewing, she chatterboxingly describes her imaginative games with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her obsession with the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her prized amethyst brooch.

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the picnic, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fabricates a elaborate confession, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was innocent, and joyfully sends her off to the picnic.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for doubting her and forcing a false confession, then sends her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful afternoon on the lake and eating ice cream. Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) recounts the entire incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), admitting her own mistake.

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school through their favorite picturesque paths while discussing their classmates, including the newly returned [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During school, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a rage and smash her slate over his head. As punishment, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stand in front of the blackboard for the rest of the day, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) when he apologizes afterward.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md)** — Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard and later forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to vow never to return to school. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to go back, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to seek advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imaginary future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her, bringing rare laughter to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) permits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for an afternoon tea party and tells her she can serve a leftover bottle of raspberry cordial. During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The next day, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together again.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious because [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) was accidentally served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to convince Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) that it was an honest mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) coldly rejects her. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to sleep, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tenderly kisses her after laughing over the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Consoled by the romantic tragedy of their separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Channeling her energy into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), excelling in most subjects despite struggling with geometry.

## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) attend a political meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her dangerously ill sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). Drawing on her past experience caring for infants, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) treats Minnie May's croup throughout the night until the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) relents on her former punishment, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to see [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rushes off in excitement and returns later in the evening to joyfully recount her wonderful afternoon, during which she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reconciled and made taffy.

## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally jumping on Diana's formidable [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who is enraged. Learning from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her in the spare-room bed. Anne's candid apology and imaginative conversation charm the old lady, prompting her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and become close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the arrival of spring and her first full year living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house after dark, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) admits that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was a "[Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood)" full of ghosts. Unimpressed by Anne's fears, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces her to walk through the spooky woods as a lesson, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) terrified but cured of her ghost-imagining habit.

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from her last day of school crying over Mr. Phillips's departure, despite her mixed feelings about him, and reports meeting Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife.
